disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict under ED-02/ED-04/ED-19. This row/variant explicitly owns AMDXIO `-xgmi -linkstatus`; row 2080 independently owns GFX RAS/CPER. The test is a complete graph/per-edge comparison: exact expected nodes/ports and AMDXIO output schema are fail-closed Project Configuration, as are binary path/version/checksum and sudo approval. No injection, CPER, driver, link, firmware or power mutation belongs here.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1958, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, shared-code row-2080 identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were read; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 1960 / Wistron-BMC-00996-V002 / fec6bde53e343fb7.
Master Procedure and Criteria independently select AMDXIO link status, ring closure and XGMI3 32 Gbps x16, so erroneous RAS package/log text is non-authoritative contamination.

Generation, speed and width are evaluated for every mapped link from complete output; exit zero or a tail cannot prove the fabric.

No AMDXIO, SSH, sudo, injection, CPER, driver, link, firmware, power, log-clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: AMDXIO read-only XGMI closed-ring and per-link XGMI3 32 Gbps x16 validation
test_case.purpose: On the exact powered SUT, use the approved AMDXIO status command to prove all expected GPU nodes form the Project ring and every required link reports healthy XGMI3 at 32 Gbps x16, independently of any RAS testcase.
required_package: Exact SUT/GPU/node/port/firmware/driver identity and versioned expected ring adjacency with directed/bidirectional counting rules
Owner-approved AMDXIO binary path, release, checksum, compatibility and documented output schema
Least-privilege approved sudo execution, secure verified host access and complete stdout/stderr/status capture
Parser mapping every node/port/link to state, generation, 32 Gbps rate and x16 width with missing/duplicate/unknown reporting
Preserved platform logs, protected evidence and explicit separation from row-2080 RAS/CPER artifacts
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; after binding target, topology and checksum-verified AMDXIO artifact, run the approved absolute-path equivalent of `sudo amdxio -xgmi -linkstatus` once through secure verified access. Preserve complete stdout/stderr/status and tool/SUT identities. Parse every node/port/edge, prove the exact graph is connected with the approved ring adjacency and closure, then require every expected link to report healthy XGMI3, 32 Gbps and x16. Preserve logs. Do not tail output, expose credentials, clear logs, inject errors, retrieve CPER, reload drivers, retrain links, change firmware/power or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: The complete normalized fabric contains every and only the approved nodes/edges, satisfies the configured ring adjacency/degree/closure rules, and each expected link is healthy at XGMI3 32 Gbps x16 with no unknown, duplicate, missing or degraded link and no command side effect.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires verified target/tool, complete successful output, exact graph equality/ring closure and every required link's state/generation/speed/width. FAIL on missing/extra/duplicate/unmapped node/link, broken ring, degraded/down link, generation/rate/width mismatch, tool/runtime error or side effect. NOT READY covers absent compatible tool, topology/schema, access or parser. RAS/CPER evidence, exit zero or truncated tail cannot PASS; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Verify AMDXIO provenance/checksum and documented read-only behavior before approved sudo execution.
Use secure verified access; never embed passwords or disable host-key verification.
Preserve complete output/logs and stop on unsupported schema or unexpected mutation; do not clear evidence.
No injection, CPER, driver reload, link retraining, firmware or power action and no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant plus row-2080 separation, SUT/GPU/firmware/driver and AMDXIO path/version/checksum
Approved node/port ring matrix and counting/schema rules
Complete raw stdout/stderr/status and normalized per-link endpoint/state/generation/rate/width table
Graph equality, connectivity/degree/ring-closure and every-link comparison including unknown/missing/duplicate report
test_case.recovery: No recovery is expected for the approved read-only command. On wrong target/tool, unsupported output, degraded link or any side effect, stop and preserve full output/logs; do not rerun, inject, reload or retrain. Use only the owner-approved GPU/driver diagnostic path if the command changed state, and keep row-2080 RAS recovery separate.
